independent_review.verdict: Arithmetic PASS; denominator suitability FAIL; overall PARTIAL; model HOLD

grounding.HARD: Raw published fields; exact as reported, not independently validated billing or token counts
grounding.DERIVED: All ratios, sums, differences, and conditional exclusion tests use only HARD inputs
grounding.PARTIAL: Name-based non-text classification; hypotheses about upstream accounting
grounding.ESTIMATE: No forecast, cache rate, correction factor, or realized ASP is estimated

guardrails.date_cost_alignment: Same-day cost alignment beats every +/-7-day shift in median absolute error
guardrails.same_scope_tokens: FAIL for model use; no documented reconciliation
guardrails.billed_revenue_semantics: UNVALIDATED; provider reported/estimated cost is not established realized revenue
guardrails.independent_provider_anchor: UNAVAILABLE; both exports are from the same source
guardrails.simple_no_cache_identity: N=U+O is rejected. Interpreting this as all-cache exclusion requires an unverified common universe and exhaustive compatible U/O definitions.
guardrails.simple_residual_duplication_identity: G=R is rejected. This does not reject other cache treatments, overlapping source fields or cohort differences.
guardrails.partial_cache_or_connection_join: UNRESOLVED; public exports lack necessary dimensions

model_gate.approved_use: Descriptive source-specific panel observations only; model mix must retain its original universe
